batch39L05BoundedFeasibility.conditionalAnalysis: If a qualified Gregorian editor establishes that cum (index 5) can be treated as a stressed monosyllable in this Psalm and cadence, sul (index 7) would be precisely two syllables after it and two syllables before the final ó (index 10). Neither that monosyllable decision nor the source-specific melodic note allocation is attested in the available witness.
batch39L05BoundedFeasibility.conclusion: There is no source-supported first-melodic-accent solution under a single artificial-secondary-accent two-after rule using the explicit natural word stresses listed above.
